views.markdown: Make the needle on Safari's app icon always point north! (iOS 15.0+)
*This is a **fork** of Skitty's original [LiveSafari](https://github.com/Skittyblock/LiveSafari) for rootless jailbreaks.*

### Version 1.2
- Fixed the Safari icon appearing square instead of using the native iOS rounded shape
- Preserved the CPU and sensor optimizations from version 1.1

### Version 1.1
- Significantly reduced CPU and sensor usage
- Stops heading updates when the Safari icon is not visible
- Cached icon assets and rendering
- Improved iPhone and iPad reliability

### Version 1.0
- Rootless support added
- Icon masking updated to squircle design
